title: Riftbound
hay: Riftbound Riftbound is Riot's League of Legends trading card game, published with UVS Games in English. These pages track Standard constructed lists.

title: Riftbound TCG
hay: Riftbound TCG Same game, search-friendly name. Constructed decks are 40 cards, one Legend, three Battlefields, twelve Runes.

title: League of Legends TCG
hay: League of Legends TCG Riftbound is the League of Legends TCG. It is not Legends of Runeterra. Lists here are paper Standard.

title: Standard
hay: Standard Standard is the only constructed legality in 2026 organized play. See the format page.

title: Vendetta
hay: Vendetta Vendetta (VEN) released 31 July 2026. It is the newest set in Standard until Radiance on 23 October 2026.

title: Radiance
hay: Radiance Radiance (RAD) is set 5, dated 23 October 2026. It will be legal for Stuttgart and Las Vegas Regional Championships.

title: Origins
hay: Origins Origins (OGN) is the launch set. It rotates with the 2026 sets on Standard's two-year clock.

title: Spiritforged
hay: Spiritforged Spiritforged (SFD) is set 2. Still Standard legal.

title: Unleashed
hay: Unleashed Unleashed (UNL) is set 3. Master Yi, Wuju Bladesman and Irelia came in as regional staples.

title: Legend
hay: Legend The Legend is the identity card. Organize decks by Legend.

title: Chosen Champion
hay: Chosen Champion One champion unit starts available. It counts toward the three-copy limit.

title: Runes
hay: Runes Twelve runes. Six domains: Fury, Calm, Mind, Body, Chaos, Order. Splits like 9–3 Chaos-Order show up in Kennen.

title: Battlefields
hay: Battlefields Three unique battlefields. In competitive 1v1 you choose one each game.

title: Domains
hay: Domains Fury (red), Calm (green), Mind (blue), Body (orange), Chaos (purple), Order (yellow). Your Legend sets which two you may play.

title: Summoner Skirmish
hay: Summoner Skirmish Local championship event through Radiance. Riot is retiring it in 2027 for Challenge Series and Nexus Cup.

title: Regional Qualifier
hay: Regional Qualifier Premier 2026 events. Barcelona, Wuhan, Singapore in this window. Become Riftbound Regionals in 2027.

title: Showdown Series
hay: Showdown Series TO-run competitive bridge events. NRG $5k is one example in August 2026.

title: Nexus Nights
hay: Nexus Nights Weekly local organized play.

title: Conquer
hay: Conquer Scoring by taking a battlefield. Fury likes it. You still have to hold to close games.

title: Hold
hay: Hold Defending a battlefield you already scored. Calm likes it.

title: Channel
hay: Channel How you bring runes into play. Banner shorthand: Channel. Conquer. Score.

title: Sideboard
hay: Sideboard Best-of-three only. Core rules: 0 or 8 cards. Some 2026 packets use 10. Copy the event document.

title: Starter decks
hay: Starter decks Champion precons exist. Official primer walks Lee Sin, Jinx, and Viktor as teaching examples.

title: Riftbound meta
hay: Riftbound meta August–September 2026: Kennen and Master Yi are the regional pair. Ornn won Barcelona. Akali won Singapore.

title: Kennen strategy
hay: Kennen strategy Chaos-Order storm. Seal of Discord, Lightning Rush, Rhasa, Stacked Deck. See Kennen lists.

title: Akali strategy
hay: Akali strategy Fury-Calm assassin that just won Singapore. See Akali lists.

title: Master Yi strategy
hay: Master Yi strategy Body-Calm combat. The Bladesman printing is the regional one. See Yi lists.

title: Ornn strategy
hay: Ornn strategy Calm-Mind forge value. Barcelona champion. See Ornn lists.

title: Fury
hay: Fury Red domain. Aggression, accelerate, conquer rewards.

title: Calm
hay: Calm Green domain. Holds, combat tricks, counters.

title: Mind
hay: Mind Blue domain. Draw, gear, long-term plans.

title: Body
hay: Body Orange domain. Ramp, efficient units, combat.

title: Chaos
hay: Chaos Purple domain. Tricks, trash, hidden.

title: Order
hay: Order Yellow domain. Go wide, death triggers, spot removal.

title: Kennen
hay: Kennen, Heart of the Tempest The most played Standard legend in Vendetta. Storm tempo that converts regional Swiss, even when it drops finals.

title: Master Yi
hay: Master Yi, Wuju Bladesman The other half of the regional puzzle. Midrange combat that still posts Top 8s beside Kennen.

title: Irelia
hay: Irelia, Blade Dancer Blade-dance tempo. High Day 1 share at Barcelona and a constant threat if Kennen is taxed.

title: Ornn
hay: Ornn, Fire Below the Mountain Barcelona champion. Forge value that beat Kennen in the first Vendetta Regional Qualifier.

title: Rengar
hay: Rengar, Pridestalker Hunt-and-conquer aggression. Barcelona Top 8 and a regular Showdown presence.

title: Akali
hay: Akali, Rogue Assassin The Singapore Regional Qualifier winner. Value lines around VEN tools that beat Kennen in the biggest final of September.

title: Azir
hay: Azir, Emperor of the Sands Token-wide emperor. Barcelona Top 4 with Guards! and Soul Sword.

title: Diana
hay: Diana, Scorn of the Moon Moonfall control/tempo. A former regional winner that still Best-Ofs in Vendetta.

title: Ezreal
hay: Ezreal, Prodigal Explorer Spell-heavy explorer. Posted Singapore Top 16s on attrition lines.

title: Fiora
hay: Fiora, Grand Duelist Duelist combat. Posted a Singapore Top 8 after a quieter Barcelona.

title: Jayce
hay: Jayce, Defender of Tomorrow Inventor ramp into bombs. Singapore RQ promo legend and a real Day 2 option.

title: Kha'Zix
hay: Kha'Zix, Voidreaver Evolve-and-isolate. Singapore Top 16 and a Barcelona Best-Of.

title: LeBlanc
hay: LeBlanc, Deceiver Mirror-image value. Best-Of at Barcelona and a Day 2 legend in Singapore.

title: Rek'Sai
hay: Rek'Sai, Void Burrower Tunnel aggression. One of Barcelona's larger Day 1 legends.

title: Nasus
hay: Nasus, Curator of the Sands Stack-might curator. High Barcelona Day 1 count, weaker conversion.

title: Draven
hay: Draven, Glorious Executioner Axes and crowd. Still a Best-Of legend when the table wants Chaos-Fury.

title: Lillia
hay: Lillia, Bashful Bloom Dream-sleep value. A Barcelona Best-Of in Calm-Mind.

title: Lucian
hay: Lucian, Purifier Double-shot purifier. Aggressive Body-Fury with Kai'Sa.

title: Mel
hay: Mel, Soul's Reflection Arcane council mage. Time Warp piles that Best-Of'd Barcelona.

title: Vex
hay: Vex, Gloomist Gloom tempo. Conversion is real when the field is full of stacked-deck piles.

title: Ambessa
hay: Ambessa, Matriarch of War Noxian war-matriarch. A Barcelona Best-Of with Wolf combat.

title: Ivern
hay: Ivern, Green Father Daisy and friends. Go-wide Calm-Order that Best-Of'd Barcelona.

title: Jax
hay: Jax, Grandmaster at Arms Grandmaster combat. Lamppost midrange with Rampage.

title: Jhin
hay: Jhin, Virtuoso Four-shot virtuoso. Spell-heavy Fury-Mind Best-Of.

title: Yi, Wuju Master
hay: Master Yi, Wuju Master The older Yi legend. Still a Best-Of at Barcelona, but the Bladesman shell is the one filling Top 8s.

title: Poppy
hay: Poppy, Keeper of the Hammer Hammer-keeper. Barcelona Best-Of in a tiny share of the field.

title: Pyke
hay: Pyke, Bloodharbor Ripper Execute from the harbor. Best-Of at Barcelona, rare in regional Top 8s.

title: Renata Glasc
hay: Renata Glasc, Chem-Baroness Chem-baron value. Hostile Takeover and porobot lines.

title: Renekton
hay: Renekton, Butcher of the Sands Rage butcher. Body-Fury combat that still takes a Best-Of.

title: Rumble
hay: Rumble, Mechanized Menace Scrap heap. Porobot and Production Surge in Fury-Mind.

title: Sett
hay: Sett, The Boss Pit-boss midrange. Low regional share, still a Showdown list.

title: Shen
hay: Shen, Eye of Twilight Kinkou tank. A Best-Of legend that lives on holds.

title: Sivir
hay: Sivir, Battle Mistress Ricochet mistress. A Barcelona Best-Of with dragons and stacked deck.

title: Vi
hay: Vi, Piltover Enforcer Gauntlet enforcer. Best-Of at Barcelona; Day 2 conversion was rough.

title: Zed
hay: Zed, Master of Shadows Shadow clones. Chaos-Fury that still Best-Ofs in Vendetta Standard.
